faculty.name: Michael Adams
faculty.summary: Studies the history, theory, and practice of lexicography, focusing on regional English variation, slang, and linguistic creativity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究词汇学的历史、理论和实践，特别是英语方言、俚语和语言创造力。

faculty.name: Patrícia Amaral
faculty.summary: Studies how lexical, contextual, and pragmatic factors affect meaning through experimental and corpus analysis methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究词汇、语境和语用因素如何影响意义，并采用语料库分析和实验方法。

faculty.name: Kelly Berkson
faculty.summary: Studies phonetics, phonology, and language documentation through field linguistics and typology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究音系学、音法学和语言记录，通过实地语言学和类型学方法。

faculty.name: Damir Cavar
faculty.summary: Studies computational linguistics and natural language processing through speech and language technologies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究计算语言学和自然语言处理，通过语音和语言技术。

faculty.name: Malgorzata Cavar
faculty.summary: Studies laboratory phonology, L2 acquisition, and theoretical phonology through linguistic analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究实验室音系学、二语习得和理论音系学。

faculty.name: Shobhana Chelliah
faculty.summary: Studies Trans-Himalayan languages and low-resourced languages through documentary linguistics and corpus linguistics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究喜马拉雅语系语言和低资源语言的音系学和语料库语言学。

faculty.name: Kenneth de Jong
faculty.summary: Studies phonological systems through experimental approaches, focusing on second language acquisition and historical dynamics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究音系系统，采用实验方法，关注第二语言习得和历史演变。

faculty.name: Laurent Dekydtspotter
faculty.summary: Studies syntactic and semantic processing in second language acquisition through neural and electrophysiological methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究第二语言习得中的句法和语义处理，采用神经和电生理方法。

faculty.name: Debra Friedman
faculty.summary: Studies language learning and teaching in classroom settings through qualitative methods, focusing on language socialization and second language writing research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究课堂语言学习和教学，通过质性方法，关注语言社会化和第二语言写作研究。

faculty.name: Luke Gessler
faculty.summary: Studies low-resource natural language processing and computational language resources.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究低资源自然语言处理和计算语言资源。

faculty.name: Thomas Grano
faculty.summary: Studies semantics and syntax-semantics interface with cross-linguistic variation, focusing on attitude reports, mood, and modality.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语义学和句法语义学界面，关注态度报告、情态和比较的跨语言变体。

faculty.name: Emily Hanink
faculty.summary: Studies syntax and its interfaces with semantics and morphology through fieldwork on indigenous languages of North America and South-Central Tibeto-Burman (Chin) languages.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究句法学及其与语义学和形态学的接口，通过田野调查研究北美原住民语言和南中喜马拉雅语系（钦语）语言。

faculty.name: Sandra Kübler
faculty.summary: Studies computational linguistics and natural language processing using machine learning techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究计算语言学和自然语言处理，使用机器学习技术。

faculty.name: Monica Nesbitt
faculty.summary: Studies African languages and linguistics, focusing on second language acquisition and psycho- and neurolinguistics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究非洲语言和语言学，侧重于第二语言习得和心理-神经语言学。

faculty.name: Samuel Gyasi Obeng
faculty.summary: Studies conversational phonetics and onomasiology in African languages through conversation analytic methodology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究非洲语言的会话音系学和语词学，通过会话分析方法论进行探讨。

faculty.name: Kevin Rottet
faculty.summary: Studies French linguistics through phonology and syntax.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究法语音系学和句法学。

faculty.name: Sun-Young Shin
faculty.summary: Studies language assessment through developing and validating authentic listening, writing, and vocabulary tests.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言评估，通过开发和验证真实听力、写作和词汇测试。

faculty.name: Shuju Shi
faculty.summary: Studies speech information processing, acoustic phonetics, and language acquisition through computer-aided methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语音信息处理、声学音位学和语言习得，采用计算机辅助方法。

faculty.name: Rex A. Sprouse
faculty.summary: Studies non-native language acquisition, focusing on phonology and Universal Grammar principles, with recent work on third language acquisition.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究非母语习得，特别是音系学和普遍语法原则，近期关注第三语言习得。

faculty.name: David Stringer
faculty.summary: Studies phonology and syntax in Spanish dialects through corpus analysis and fieldwork.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究西班牙语方言的音系学和句法学，通过语料库分析和田野调查进行。

faculty.name: Francis M. Tyers
faculty.summary: Studies marginalized languages and morphosyntax using computational methods like machine translation and dependency parsing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究边缘语言和形态句法，使用计算语言学方法如机器翻译和依存句法分析。

faculty.name: Barbara S. Vance
faculty.summary: Studies syntactic changes in French over 1200 years, focusing on word order and sentence relations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究法语语法变化，重点关注词序和句法关系在1200年历史中的演变。

faculty.name: Yucel Yilmaz
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of corrective feedback and cognitive aptitudes on second language acquisition through various experimental methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究纠错反馈和认知能力对二语习得的影响，采用多种实验方法。

faculty.name: Deborah Cohn
faculty.summary: Studies the cultural and political contexts of 20th-century Spanish American literature and Cold War cultural diplomacy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究20世纪拉美文学的文化和政治背景以及冷战文化外交。

faculty.name: Leslie Del Carpio
faculty.summary: Studies Spanish linguistics through phonological and morphosyntactic analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究西班牙语音系学和形态句法学。

faculty.name: Manuel Díaz-Campos
faculty.summary: Studies Spanish and Portuguese through phonology and morphology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究西班牙语和葡萄牙语的音系学和形态学。

faculty.name: Patrick Dove
faculty.summary: Studies literature, philosophy, and political thought in Spanish America, focusing on conflict and violence in Central America.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究拉丁美洲的文学、哲学和政治思想，重点关注中美洲的冲突和暴力。

faculty.name: J. César Félix-Brasdefer
faculty.summary: Studies pragmatics and second language pragmatics through discourse analysis and instruction.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语用学和第二语言语用学，通过话语分析和教学进行探讨。

faculty.name: Ryan Giles
faculty.summary: Studies medieval and Renaissance Iberian literature, focusing on parody and satire, intersections with sanctity and popular devotion, and material culture.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究中世纪和文艺复兴时期的伊比利亚文学，重点关注讽刺和 satire，以及神圣性和通俗信仰的交集和物质文化。

faculty.name: Laura Gurzynski-Weiss
faculty.summary: Studies second language acquisition in classroom settings through cognitive-interactionist and usage-based frameworks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究课堂环境中的第二语言习得，通过认知互动主义和使用主义框架。

faculty.name: Edgar Illas
faculty.summary: Studies modern and contemporary Catalan culture, secessionism, and the political theory of survival and war.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究现代和当代加泰罗尼亚文化、独立主义以及生存和战争的政治理论。

faculty.name: Rhi Johnson
faculty.summary: Studies the cultural production of modern Iberia, focusing on gender and sexuality, with a particular emphasis on 18th and 19th century literature and visual culture.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究现代伊比利亚的文化生产，特别是18世纪和19世纪的文学和视觉文化，关注性别与性取向。

faculty.name: Alejandro Mejías-López
faculty.summary: Studies modernism and modernity in Spanish America and Spain through cultural and literary analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究西班牙美洲和西班牙的现代主义和现代性，通过文化与文学分析。

faculty.name: Kathleen Myers
faculty.summary: Studies the history and culture of colonial Mexico through literature and historical narratives.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究殖民时期的墨西哥历史和文化，通过文学和历史叙事。

faculty.name: M. Gabriela Pusca
faculty.summary: Studies Spanish and Portuguese languages through linguistic analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究西班牙语和葡萄牙语的语言学分析。

faculty.name: Estela Vieira
faculty.summary: Studies nineteenth-century Lusophone literature, film, and cultural identity through comparative literature and film analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究19世纪的卢西phone文学、电影和文化身份，通过比较文学和电影分析进行。

faculty.name: Erik W. Willis
faculty.summary: Studies Spanish phonology through experimental methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究西班牙语音系学通过实验方法。

faculty.name: Julie Anderson
faculty.summary: Studies speech disfluencies through laboratory research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究言语中断通过实验室研究。

faculty.name: Tessa Bent
faculty.summary: Studies children's and adult's perception of speech accents and barriers in healthcare communication through active-learning methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人对口音语音感知以及医疗保健沟通中的障碍，采用主动学习方法。

faculty.name: Gavin Bidelman
faculty.summary: Studies auditory cognition and neuroscience through hearing science research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究听觉认知和神经科学。

faculty.name: Ishanti Gangopadhyay
faculty.summary: Studies language development and disorders, particularly in monolingual and bilingual children, using cognitive and experimental methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言发展和障碍，特别是在单语和双语儿童中的认知和实验方法。

faculty.name: Samantha Gustafson
faculty.summary: Studies communication challenges in school-age children with and without hearing loss using subjective, behavioral, and electrophysiologic methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究听力正常和听力障碍儿童的沟通挑战，使用主观、行为和电生理方法。

faculty.name: Jennifer Lentz
faculty.summary: Studies auditory perception in listeners with normal hearing and hearing loss, developing assessment tools for tinnitus and evaluating hearing aid algorithms.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究正常听力和听力损失听者的听觉感知，开发耳鸣评估工具并评估助听器算法。

faculty.name: Steven Lulich
faculty.summary: Studies speech production and modeling using 3D/4D ultrasound imaging techniques to explore the intersection of anatomy, articulation, acoustics, and aerodynamics in phonological systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究发音生产与建模，使用3D/4D超声成像技术探索解剖学、发音、声学和气动学在音系系统中的交集。

faculty.name: Carol Mesa
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of literacy interventions on bilingual children's reading skills through randomized controlled trials and single-subject designs.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究双语儿童阅读技能的干预效果，通过随机对照试验和单被试设计进行。

faculty.name: Rita Patel
faculty.summary: Studies vocal physiology and voice production in normal and disordered voice across the lifespan, focusing on pediatric vocal development and spasmodic dysphonia.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究正常和异常声音的发音生理学，特别是在儿童声音发展和痉挛性失声症方面的研究。

faculty.name: Caroline Spencer
faculty.summary: Studies speech production and neural mechanisms in disorders through behavioral and neurological approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究言语产生和神经机制在障碍中的表现和神经学方法。
